title: Check RMS fleet status for AGVs in shutdown queues and zone cycling
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI to verify that AGVs are held in shutdown queues (shutdown state), then cycle into their assigned zones (4 zones) after startup, consistent with the system state model described in the segment.
when_to_use: When you need to confirm that AGVs are in the shutdown state (shutdown queues) and then transition into their assigned zones (4 zones) after startup, using the live fleet status view in RMS.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the RMS fleet-status checks for AGV state/location and confirm whether AGVs transition from shutdown queues into their assigned zones after startup.

system_preconditions: System is expected to be in/transitioning through startup and shutdown logic (shutdown queues → zone cycling).

visual_references.description: Training video frame segment (timestamp ~00:47:36.500) containing the shutdown queues → cycle → 4 zones explanation and the mention of AGVs cycling through charging while in shutdown logic.

steps.title: Open RMS / fleet status UI and view AGV roster/map
steps.purpose: Get to the live fleet/AGV view needed to check each AGV’s current state and/or location/zone assignment.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) and navigate to the AGV list/map view where you can see each AGV’s current state and/or location/zone assignment.
steps.expected_result: You can see the AGV list/map view in RMS with each AGV’s current state and/or location/zone assignment visible.
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS fleet status view is accessible and shows AGVs with state/location/zone information (enough to distinguish shutdown queues vs zone assignments).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot access the RMS fleet status view, or the view does not provide any observable state/location/zone information for AGVs.

actions.label: Open RMS fleet status UI
actions.exact_action: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (RMS / fleet status UI).

stop_or_escalate_if: RMS fleet status UI is not accessible or does not show AGV state/location/zone fields needed for the check.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Shut down queues is just where it sits when it's shut down… when they start up, they move into their own zones… Here we have 4 zones.”

steps.title: Confirm AGVs are in shutdown queues (shutdown state)
steps.purpose: Validate that the expected AGVs are currently held in shutdown queues (shutdown state) rather than being in idle/running zone assignments.
steps.instruction: In the RMS AGV list/map view, identify the relevant AGVs and confirm that their current state and/or location/zone assignment corresponds to shutdown queues (shutdown state), not idle/running zones.
steps.expected_result: AGVs that should be in shutdown are displayed in a shutdown queues/shutdown state condition in RMS (observable via their state and/or location/zone assignment).
steps.healthy_condition: AGVs expected to be in shutdown are consistently shown as being in shutdown queues/shutdown state.
steps.failure_condition: AGVs expected to be in shutdown are shown in non-shutdown zone assignments (i.e., not in shutdown queues/shutdown state).

actions.label: Check each AGV state/location
actions.exact_action: Locate the AGV list/map view and identify each AGV’s current state and/or location/zone assignment.

stop_or_escalate_if: AGVs are not shown in shutdown queues/shutdown state when shutdown is expected.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Shut down queues is just where it sits when it's shut down… They're all in like a shutdown state…”

steps.title: Observe transition from shutdown queues into assigned zones (4 zones)
steps.purpose: Verify the expected startup behavior: AGVs move from shutdown queues into their assigned zones (4 zones).
steps.instruction: Observe the AGVs in RMS over the expected startup transition window and confirm they move from shutdown queues into their assigned zones. The segment references 4 zones.
steps.expected_result: AGVs transition from shutdown queues/shutdown state into their assigned zones (4 zones referenced in the segment).
steps.healthy_condition: AGVs move out of shutdown queues into zone assignments rather than remaining in shutdown state.
steps.failure_condition: AGVs remain in shutdown queues/shutdown state without transitioning into their assigned zones when startup is expected.

actions.label: Watch for zone cycling
actions.exact_action: Observe whether the AGVs transition from shutdown queues into their assigned zones (the segment mentions 4 zones).

stop_or_escalate_if: AGVs remain in shutdown queues/shutdown state without transitioning into their zones when the system is expected to be starting up.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “when they start up, they move into their own zones… Here we have 4 zones. So they go from shutdown queues, they go into their zones…”

steps.title: If tipper/hospital scenario is active, confirm shutdown/startup cycle still holds
steps.purpose: The segment includes a scenario involving tipper/hospital/reject handling; ensure AGVs still follow the shutdown queues → zones behavior rather than getting stuck in shutdown.
steps.instruction: If the segment’s scenario is active (tipper issue leading to hospital/reject handling), confirm in RMS that AGVs still follow the shutdown/startup cycle model: shutdown queues → assigned zones, rather than remaining stuck in shutdown queues.
steps.expected_result: Even during the tipper/hospital scenario, AGVs still transition from shutdown queues into their assigned zones in RMS.
steps.healthy_condition: No prolonged retention in shutdown queues beyond what the shutdown/startup logic implies; AGVs still enter their zone assignments.
steps.failure_condition: AGVs remain stuck in shutdown queues/shutdown state during the scenario when they should be cycling into zones.

actions.label: Validate cycle behavior during scenario
actions.exact_action: Confirm that AGVs are still behaving according to the shutdown/startup cycle model (shutdown queues → zones) rather than remaining stuck in shutdown queues.

stop_or_escalate_if: AGVs remain in shutdown queues/shutdown state without transitioning into their zones during the scenario.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Segment context includes: “something wrong with Tipper… ADV sent to hospital… Question shut down queue is where… it sits when it's shut down… when they start up, they move into their own zones… Here we have 4 zones.”

success_criteria: In RMS, AGVs expected to be in shutdown are shown in shutdown queues/shutdown state.
After startup, those AGVs transition from shutdown queues into their assigned zones (4 zones referenced).
During any tipper/hospital scenario, AGVs still follow shutdown queues → zones behavior rather than remaining stuck in shutdown.
healthy_conditions: AGVs expected to be in shutdown are consistently shown in shutdown queues/shutdown state in RMS.
AGVs transition out of shutdown queues into zone assignments after startup.
failure_conditions: AGVs remain in shutdown queues/shutdown state without transitioning into their assigned zones when startup is expected.
RMS shows AGVs in non-shutdown zone assignments during a shutdown period.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if AGVs remain in shutdown queues/shutdown state without transitioning into their zones when the system is expected to be starting up.
Escalate if RMS shows inconsistent state/location (e.g., AGVs not in shutdown queues during a shutdown period, or not entering zones after startup).
